outside_sources.title: Blender Manual — Store Named Attribute Node
outside_sources.author: Blender Documentation Team / Blender Foundation

technique_notes: GeometryNodeCaptureAttribute data_type='FLOAT' domain='POINT': inputs[0]=Geometry inputs[1]=Value; outputs[0]=Geometry outputs[1]=Attribute
CaptureAttribute forces field evaluation at the specified domain at the current position in the node tree — downstream domain changes cannot corrupt the stored value
GeometryNodeStoreNamedAttribute data_type='FLOAT' domain='INSTANCE': inputs[2]=Name(string) inputs[3]=Value — stores value to mesh data, visible in Spreadsheet, survives export_apply
INSTANCE domain attrs propagate to every POINT of each realized instance after RealizeInstances — all N vertices of sphere k get the same colour_phase
ShaderNodeAttribute attribute_type='GEOMETRY' reads a named attribute in the EEVEE material — outputs[2]=Fac is the float scalar for colour ramp input
GeometryNodeIcoSphere + GeometryNodeSetMaterial assigns material inside GN tree before instancing — no external prototype object required
export_apply=True required — runtimes do not evaluate GN; 'colour_phase' exports as a custom glTF vertex attribute _COLOUR_PHASE
Field laziness: Index, Position, RandomValue are field expressions not stored values; they re-evaluate at whatever domain is active at point of consumption
